class.name: SpineSprite3D
class.brief_description: A node for animating and rendering a Spine skeleton in a 3D scene.
class.description: [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] animates and draws a Spine skeleton in 3D. The skeleton lies on the local XY plane. Spine Y maps to Godot -Y. Assign a shared [code]SpineSkeletonDataResource[/code] to [code]skeleton_data_res[/code]. The resource holds skeleton data, atlas data, and animation mixes. Use [code]get_animation_state()[/code] to play animations. Use [code]get_skeleton()[/code] to read bones, slots, constraints, and skins. Skin and animation APIs match [code]SpineSprite2D[/code]. To play an animation from code, call [code]get_animation_state().set_animation("walk", true, 0)[/code]. The second argument sets looping. The third argument is the track index. Track 0 is the main layer. Call [code]get_animation_state().add_animation("jump", 0, false, 0)[/code] to queue an animation after the current one on the same track. To switch skin from code, call [code]get_skeleton().set_skin_by_name("full-skins/girl")[/code] with a skin name from your skeleton data. Pass [code]null[/code] to [code]get_skeleton().set_skin()[/code] for the default skin. For mix-and-match, create a skin with [code]new_skin("custom-skin")[/code], add parts with [code]SpineSkin.add_skin(get_skeleton().get_data().find_skin("hair/brown"))[/code], then call [code]get_skeleton().set_skin(custom_skin)[/code]. After a skin switch, call [code]get_skeleton().set_slots_to_setup_pose()[/code] so slot attachments refresh. When [code]update_mode[/code] is [code]Manual[/code], call [code]update_skeleton(delta)[/code] each frame after you change skin or animation. Each slot renders through an internal [code]SpineMesh3D[/code] child. You do not add these children yourself. Rendering options follow [code]Sprite3D[/code]: [code]pixel_size[/code], [code]flip_h[/code], [code]flip_v[/code], [code]modulate[/code], billboard mode, texture filter, and render priority. Toggle rendering behavior with inspector flags or with [code]set_draw_flag()[/code] and [code]get_draw_flag()[/code] using [code]DrawFlags[/code] constants. Set [code]update_mode[/code] to [code]Process[/code], [code]Physics[/code], or [code]Manual[/code]. In manual mode, call [code]update_skeleton()[/code] each frame. Override blend materials with [code]normal_material[/code], [code]additive_material[/code], [code]multiply_material[/code], and [code]screen_material[/code]. When unset, the node uses built-in materials per slot blend mode. Use [code]get_global_bone_transform()[/code] and [code]set_global_bone_transform()[/code] to read or write bone poses in global space. Call [code]set_global_bone_transform()[/code] before world transforms update. Signals match [code]SpineSprite2D[/code]: animation lifecycle events, editor preview hooks, and hooks before and after animation state and bone transform updates. Debug properties draw bones, regions, meshes, bounding boxes, paths, and clipping in the editor viewport. Editor preview properties ([code]preview_skin[/code], [code]preview_animation[/code], [code]preview_frame[/code], [code]preview_time[/code]) appear when skeleton data is loaded.

method.name: generate_triangle_mesh
method.description: Builds a combined triangle mesh from all slot surfaces. The editor uses this mesh for 3D selection and picking.

method.name: get_draw_flag
method.description: Returns the value of the draw flag at [code]flag[/code]. Use [code]FLAG_TRANSPARENT[/code], [code]FLAG_SHADED[/code], [code]FLAG_DOUBLE_SIDED[/code], [code]FLAG_DISABLE_DEPTH_TEST[/code], or [code]FLAG_FIXED_SIZE[/code].

method.name: get_animation_state
method.description: Returns the animation state for this sprite. Use [code]set_animation()[/code] and [code]add_animation()[/code] on the result to change playback from code.

method.name: get_global_bone_transform
method.description: Returns the global transform of the named bone.

method.name: get_skeleton
method.description: Returns the live skeleton for this sprite. Use [code]set_skin()[/code], [code]set_skin_by_name()[/code], and [code]set_slots_to_setup_pose()[/code] on the result to change skin from code.

method.name: get_time_scale
method.description: Returns the animation playback speed multiplier applied during [code]update_skeleton()[/code].

method.name: is_flipped_h
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the sprite mirrors horizontally around the skeleton bounds center.

method.name: is_flipped_v
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the sprite mirrors vertically around the skeleton bounds center.

method.name: new_skin
method.description: Creates a new empty skin on the skeleton. Add attachments from other skins with [code]SpineSkin.add_skin()[/code].

method.name: refresh_display
method.description: Reloads atlas page textures from disk, rebuilds slot meshes, and reapplies materials. Call this when slot surfaces stay gray after atlas PNG import or after switching the editor to the 3D tab.

method.name: set_draw_flag
method.description: Sets the draw flag at [code]flag[/code]. Each [code]DrawFlags[/code] constant maps to one inspector toggle: [code]transparent[/code], [code]shaded[/code], [code]double_sided[/code], [code]no_depth_test[/code], or [code]fixed_size[/code].

method.name: on_skeleton_data_changed
method.description: Reloads internal skeleton and animation objects after [code]skeleton_data_res[/code] changes. Called automatically when the resource updates.

method.name: set_global_bone_transform
method.description: Sets the global transform of the named bone. Call this before world transforms are computed for the frame.

method.name: set_time_scale
method.description: Sets the animation playback speed multiplier applied during [code]update_skeleton()[/code].

method.name: update_skeleton
method.description: Updates the animation state, applies it to the skeleton, and rebuilds slot meshes. Required each frame when [code]update_mode[/code] is [code]Manual[/code].

method.name: visual_settings_changed
method.description: Rebuilds slot meshes and editor pick geometry after visual properties change. The engine calls this when you change flip, modulate, materials, or draw flags.

signal.name: _internal_spine_objects_invalidated
signal.description: Emitted when internal Spine skeleton or animation objects are destroyed and recreated. Advanced tooling uses this to drop stale references.

signal.name: animation_completed
signal.description: Emitted when a track entry completes a loop. May fire during mix out.

signal.name: animation_disposed
signal.description: Emitted when a track entry is disposed. Do not keep references to the entry after this signal.

signal.name: animation_ended
signal.description: Emitted when a track entry will never apply again after it was the current entry.

signal.name: animation_event
signal.description: Emitted when a Spine event fires on a track entry. May fire during mix out.

signal.name: animation_interrupted
signal.description: Emitted when another entry replaces this entry as the current track entry.

signal.name: animation_started
signal.description: Emitted when a track entry becomes the current entry on its track.

signal.name: before_animation_state_apply
signal.description: Emitted before the animation state applies poses to the skeleton.

signal.name: before_animation_state_update
signal.description: Emitted before the animation state advances time for the frame.

signal.name: before_world_transforms_change
signal.description: Emitted before bone world transforms are computed.

signal.name: world_transforms_changed
signal.description: Emitted after bone world transforms are computed.
